title: Lee's funeral
summary: Mary arranged a quick, small funeral because she was exhausted.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: When, after, at his funeral, who was, everybody came?

Well, not exactly because I, really I was tired. And I had, I made the arrangements for the funeral. And it was in our way. In a hurry, in a hurry, in a hurry. Right. And a lot of people said I shouldn't. But nobody realized that with me alone and having everything to do and in and out every night to the hospital, I would sit up. The doctors really insisted I would leave because they figured that I would be in the next bed. But I just couldn't, I couldn't do it. I wanted to be there with him. So, I, then after he passed, I said, well, why not just go ahead and have the funeral? But we had quite a few, you know, musicians and friends there. But it wasn't like it would have been a big funeral. I didn't want that. I was tired.
